Variables
dc_mode1_ct
dc_mode1_ct:: .db 0x00

Mode 1 Color conversion table (PEN to Screen pixel format)

This simple table converts PEN values (palette indexes from 0 to 3) into screen pixel format values in mode 1.  In mode 1, each byte has 4 pixels (P0, P1, P2, P3). This table converts the PEN value to a byte that has the 4 pixels in the given PEN value colour.
